name: MacNativeGames
description: Play your own Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild natively on Apple silicon Mac, iPhone and iPad. Not an emulator: the game's ARM64 code runs directly, NVN rebuilt on Metal. Bring your own game.

latest_release.name: MacNativeGames 2026-10-25
latest_release.body:
First tagged snapshot of MacNativeGames. There is no app to download: this release is the source. Build the app on your own Mac from your own game files as the [README](https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames#readme) explains. The repository contains no game content, keys or shaders.

## Supported

- **Tears of the Kingdom** 1.0.0, 1.2.1, 1.4.3: Mac, iPhone and iPad
- **Breath of the Wild** 1.6.0 and 1.9.0: Mac; 1.6.0 also on iPhone
- Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26; iPhone / iPad builds need iOS / iPadOS 26 and iPhone 14 or newer

## Highlights (October 17 – 25)

- **Breath of the Wild 1.6.0 on the iPhone**: full screen, add-on content, saves copied from the Mac; both games render at 960x540 on the phone and use their own upscale to 1280x720
- **Tears of the Kingdom on iPhone and iPad** fills the screen, 60 fps by default, MetalFX upscaling
- **Breath of the Wild 1.6.0 / 1.9.0 on the Mac**: frame interpolation (key 2), native 2K (key 3), 21:9 ultrawide (key 4), edge smoothing (key 5); every shader prepared at build time
- **Tears of the Kingdom on the Mac** renders its 3D scene at the canvas resolution (1920x1080 at 1080p, 2560x1440 on the 2K canvas); key 4 cycles 16:9 → fit to the window → 21:9
- **Shared shader list**: every build prepares the game's shaders before the title, and the list players send in removes stutter for everyone. The Mac reminder now also has a "Like it? Star it on GitHub" button that opens this page
- Super Mario Odyssey 1.3.0 community port (early) in [`games/odyssey`](https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames/tree/main/games/odyssey)

## Known issues

- The first visit to a new place can stutter while new shaders compile
- Long-session memory growth and occasional audio underruns are under investigation

Not affiliated with Nintendo. You must own the game.
